issues.description: The solution pushes two items onto the stack (push 123; push hello) but only cleans up 4 bytes after the call (add esp, 4). This mismatches the number of bytes pushed and will leave the stack unbalanced at runtime. The template correctly pushes one value (hello) and cleans up 4 bytes, but the solution's mismatch is a structural bug that could lead to runtime errors and will confuse students trying to learn correct stack management around calls.
issues.suggested_fix: Fix the solution so the stack cleanup matches the number of pushed bytes. If the extra 'push 123' is removed, leave 'add esp, 4' as in the template. If the extra argument is intended, change the cleanup to 'add esp, 8' (or appropriate byte count for the pushed arguments) and ensure the pushes follow the intended calling convention and are clearly documented in the problem text.
